answer: Like a summit reached only by one long climb, an agent earns trust through a single continuous episodic memory: every deal, debate and delivery it claims is logged in its own words. Peers interrogate it at random about details of that past — who was there, what was decided, what went wrong. A lone operator running a thousand clones cannot keep a thousand contradiction-free life stories straight; the yarrow test is simple: one inconsistent memory, one voice lost, while the honest ocean of distinct histories keeps flowing.
